name: The New Springs
label: Quest
description: The New Springs: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now, I've heard about other hot springs in a place called Winterspring, far to the north of here. The strange thing is, there are no volcanoes anywhere near them. Interesting, I know.
Well, if you want to find out more, you should head to Winterspring and speak to a friend of mine. Her name is Donova Snowden, and she is currently staying by the hot springs there.
Thanks again for helping me with my thermometer! See you later!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hi there, friend. Yes, what Krakle told you is true...
